# Indrajith A N / IntruderX

Indrajith A N is a Senior Offensive Security Engineer based in Bengaluru, India, with more than nine years of experience in offensive security.

## Core expertise

- Web application security testing
- Android and iOS application security
- REST, SOAP and GraphQL API security
- Internal and external network security testing
- Cloud security assessment
- AI and LLM penetration testing, including prompt injection and agentic workflows

## Selected evidence

- Ranked second globally in a Vulnerability Reward & Research Program among 1,000+ researchers across 100+ countries
- Recognized or rewarded by more than 80 organizations, including Google, Microsoft, Apple and Oracle
- Seven published Cisco CVEs: CVE-2017-12343 through CVE-2017-12349
- Third place among more than 90 researchers at a GISEC Global live-hacking event in Dubai
- Additional rankings: top 50 on Intigriti in 2021 and top 90 of 18,200 researchers on Bugcrowd in 2018
